quarterly_data.signal: Trane Technologies' second-quarter 2026 results release: record bookings of $7.8 billion, up 39 percent, with book-to-bill of 123 percent; reported revenues of $6.4 billion, up 11 percent; Americas Commercial HVAC backlog up 90 percent. The Americas segment posted all-time high bookings of $6.6 billion, up 44 percent, with book-to-bill of 124 percent. Full-year 2026 guidance was raised to reported revenue growth of approximately 11.5 percent and GAAP continuing EPS of approximately $15.00 to $15.10.
